snippet.title: Chappell Roan is the Fortnite Festival Season 13 Icon!
snippet.description:
Just having fun where she belongs: the Midwest Princess herself, Chappell Roan, has arrived in Fortnite as our Fortnite Festival Season 13 icon! Read more: https://fn.gg/ChappellRoan
